candidate.title: scRNA-Seq
candidate.scope: The single linear 'Single-cell mRNA sequencing (scRNA-seq)' schematic: poly(A)-tailed mRNA from an individually processed cell is primed, copied to cDNA, subjected to the depicted ExoSAP-IT-associated block, amplified and sheared to DNA. This is the illustrated oligo(dT)/cDNA-tailing implementation within the wider scRNA-Seq family. ExoSAP-IT is a component, and no alternative target workflow or branch is drawn. The endpoint precedes unshown final sequencing-library preparation and sequencing.

operations.label: Reverse transcription and primer digestion with ExoSAP-IT
operations.description: Retain this combined source caption. Between the first-strand hybrid and the next panel, free-primer digestion is reported, the RNA body ceases to be drawn, and cDNA acquires an opposite-end poly(A)/poly(T)-primer interface. Catalogue prose identifies first-strand cDNA 3′ poly(A) tailing and annealing of a second poly(T) primer for second-strand generation. The product drawn at this boundary has one long blue strand and the short second primer; the expanded complementary strand is visible at the PCR endpoint.
operations.mechanism: Catalogue-supported exonuclease I removal of unreacted primers followed by first-strand cDNA poly(A) tailing and poly(T) annealing. The figure names ExoSAP-IT but does not establish it as the enzyme responsible for tail addition or identify an RNA-removal mechanism.
operations.information_effect: Introduces a second primer interface at the new cDNA 3′ tail, enabling production and amplification of a duplex copy of the captured transcript.

research_questions.question: Research needed for the primary-paper association, rather than a correction to the depicted route. Independent inspection supports all seven material states, all five local operations and all eleven routes: poly(A)-mRNA is primed, copied into cDNA, given the opposite-end tail/primer interface, amplified and sheared into DNA. The graph retains the primer-derived ends and correctly stops before unshown final library construction and sequencing. The matched collection page confirms the schematic target, while the card's two main references describe mNET-seq. None of the supplied primary-paper content establishes the exact depicted oligo(dT)/cDNA-poly(A)-tailing implementation; the other seven papers have abstract-only content and are appropriately retained as background. Resolve u_primary_association by obtaining a method-matched primary passage or figure, with collection reference 164 (Tang et al., 2009) as a lead, and record its actual association with scRNA-Seq. Do not infer chemistry, priority or an origin date from the bibliography alone.

Which primary paper establishes this exact scRNA-Seq oligo(dT)/first-strand-cDNA-poly(A)-tailing implementation, including how primer digestion, second priming and second-strand generation map onto the combined ExoSAP-IT-captioned block? The two supplied method references describe mNET-Seq. The matching collection page lists Tang et al. (2009), but no Tang paper or metadata source is supplied; the remaining papers provide review/application abstracts rather than this implementation's chemistry.
